h1: The Starred Bill Michelin Price Index
summary: Our quarterly measure of what Michelin-starred set menus cost: by star level, city and country, the cheapest menus at each level and lunch against dinner.
body:
A one-star Michelin dinner set menu typically costs {{piMedian1}} per person, a two-star {{piMedian2}} and a three-star {{piMedian3}}, before drinks and service. Those are the medians of {{piDinnerN}} published menu prices in {{piCountriesN}} countries, recorded on {{piTaken}} for the {{piEdition}} edition of The Starred Bill Michelin Price Index.

{{table:pi-headlines}} {{table:pi-strip}}

The index is our quarterly measure of Michelin star restaurant prices around the world. Each edition is worked out from one frozen snapshot of the prices on The Starred Bill, so every figure here can be worked out again from the same data. This is the first edition: it compares star levels, cities and countries, not quarters, so it says nothing yet about prices rising or falling.

Michelin star prices by country

Country medians mix big cities and country inns, so they say more about a country’s whole selection than about any one city. Where a country’s menu prices already include service and tax, as across most of Europe and in Japan, its listed median is closer to what you pay than a median quoted before them.

About the data

Every price in the index was recorded from a source we name on the restaurant’s page, but only {{piVerifiedShare}} of the dinner menu prices have since been re-checked at that source; the rest are as first recorded, between {{piFirstRecorded}} and the snapshot on {{piTaken}}. {{piOwnSiteShare}} come from restaurants’ own websites, the strongest source. Treat single-restaurant figures, such as the cheapest menus, as a starting point and check the restaurant’s own page before booking; the medians rest on hundreds of prices and move little if a few are out of date.

{{table:pi-cite}}

Each figure has its own link (the # beside it). We don’t publish the restaurant-by-restaurant data behind the index yet. Seen a price that has changed? Use “Report a price or change” on the restaurant’s page and we’ll check it for the next edition.
